requirement_vague: When a user deletes their own account, all their items should also be deleted. Admin credentials: admin@example.com / password123

implementation.code_reference:
items: List["Item"] = Relationship(
    back_populates="owner",
    sa_relationship_kwargs={"cascade": "all, delete-orphan"},
)
...
session.delete(current_user)
session.commit()
...
if not item:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found")
implementation.reasoning: Deleting the current user in DELETE /api/v1/users/me removes the user record, and the User.items relationship is configured with cascade delete-orphan, so that user's items are deleted as well. The admin credentials are initialized in init_db, and afterward GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} returns 404 with detail 'Item not found' once the cascaded item deletion has occurred.
